dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Hey there, lil' deer. Want some Midsommar Berries? I just picked these.

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Oop, and they're all gone... Guess it really did like 'em.

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: #Hey there, {NICKNAME}! We're... uh, on an outing!

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: And we meet this deer on our trip. It's super cute!

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: #Hey, little deer, can {NICKNAME}, Kari, and I touch you? If you're okay with it... just nod.

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Kari! It really can hear what I say! Lauma's right, deer really are clever!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hehehe, there, there, that's a good deer!

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: It's coming closer. That's so cute... Hehe. Here you go, have these Lakkaberries too. Eat them slowly now...

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: *sigh* If only I could understand animal speech just like Lauma can.

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: If I could do that, I wouldn't ever have to sit by myself and just... do nothing...

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Come on, Kari. Didn't I say I'd play with you all day tomorrow? I've even prepared a ton of toys. It'll be great.

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Thank you. But I... still get scared when I sleep alone at night...

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Oh yeah. Didn't we pick up an injured puffin the other day? Didn't your parents let you keep it at home?

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Yeah, but its injury has already healed. Granny Sarakka said that nature is an animal's true home, and that keeping it indoors all day might do it harm.

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: But I... couldn't bear to see it leave, so I left it over there. I thought that if it didn't fly away, then, y'know, maybe it wanted to stay and be my friend...

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: But then, when I woke up, it was gone.

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Ah... Come on, don't be sad. Maybe that little puffin just... went to its parents to tell them it's well. Maybe it'll come back to see you once it gets permission to.

response.speaker: Ina
response.text: See? That puffin could be one of its family members, for all we know.

response.speaker: Kari
response.text: But we don't, Ina. I'm not Miss Lauma. All puffins look the same to me...

response.speaker: Kari
response.text: There's no way I could tell them apart unless they could talk...

response.speaker: Ina
response.text: But see, they're all puffins, right? I'm sure they know each other, so let's just ask it to help us find that little puffin.

response.speaker: Ina
response.text: Here, take some Midsommar Berries and go feed it.

response.speaker: Kari
response.text: O... Okay. Well... Please, Mister Puffin... or Miss Puffin... if you know the little puffin who was staying at my place...

response.speaker: Kari
response.text: Ugh, I'm getting all turned around now, aren't I...

response.speaker: Kari
response.text: Still! I miss that puffin a lot. If you know it, could you ask it to come back and see me?

response.speaker: Ina
response.text: No response... Did it not like these berries? I can go fetch a different kind. Just a moment.

response.speaker: Kari
response.text: Hey, don't fly away! Please don't go! I still have something to tell you!

choices.text: For all you know, they might just know each other.
